_: The foreign texts quoted on the site. Each quotation is cut from a text that tools/sources.js fetched (verification/sources-raw.json, the article named by `law` and `article`), between two places in it, and is not altered except that a space before a closing bracket or punctuation mark is removed. verification/check.js confirms that each occurs in its article with the same removal. Japanese statutes are not listed here: they are quoted in full from verification/statutes-texts.json or from the e-Gov texts in verification/sources-raw.json.

GDPR 3.name: General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Article 3(2)
GDPR 3.name_ja: 一般データ保護規則（EU 2016/679）第3条第2項
GDPR 3.quote: 2. This Regulation applies to the processing of personal data of data subjects who are in the Union by a controller or processor not established in the Union, where the processing activities are related to: (a) the offering of goods or services, irrespective of whether a payment of the data subject is required, to such data subjects in the Union; or (b) the monitoring of their behaviour as far as their behaviour takes place within the Union.

GDPR 17.name: General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Article 17(3)(a)
GDPR 17.name_ja: 一般データ保護規則（EU 2016/679）第17条第3項(a)
GDPR 17.quote: 3. Paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply to the extent that processing is necessary: (a) for exercising the right of freedom of expression and information;

GDPR 20.name: General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Article 20(1)
GDPR 20.name_ja: 一般データ保護規則（EU 2016/679）第20条第1項
GDPR 20.quote: 1. The data subject shall have the right to receive the personal data concerning him or her, which he or she has provided to a controller, in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format and have the right to transmit those data to another controller without hindrance from the controller to which the personal data have been provided, where: (a) the processing is based on consent pursuant to point (a) of Article 6(1) or point (a) of Article 9(2) or on a contract pursuant to point (b) of Article 6(1); and (b) the processing is carried out by automated means.

GDPR 27.name: General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Article 27(1) and (2)
GDPR 27.name_ja: 一般データ保護規則（EU 2016/679）第27条第1項・第2項
GDPR 27.quote: 1. Where Article 3(2) applies, the controller or the processor shall designate in writing a representative in the Union. 2. The obligation laid down in paragraph 1 of this Article shall not apply to: (a) processing which is occasional, does not include, on a large scale, processing of special categories of data as referred to in Article 9(1) or processing of personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences referred to in Article 10, and is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons, taking into account the nature, context, scope and purposes of the processing; or (b) a public authority or body.

GDPR 49.name: General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Article 49(1)(a)
GDPR 49.name_ja: 一般データ保護規則（EU 2016/679）第49条第1項(a)
GDPR 49.quote: 1. In the absence of an adequacy decision pursuant to Article 45(3), or of appropriate safeguards pursuant to Article 46, including binding corporate rules, a transfer or a set of transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation shall take place only on one of the following conditions: (a) the data subject has explicitly consented to the proposed transfer, after having been informed of the possible risks of such transfers for the data subject due to the absence of an adequacy decision and appropriate safeguards;

PIPL 53.name: Personal Information Protection Law of the People’s Republic of China, Article 53 (the English text of the National People’s Congress)
PIPL 53.name_ja: 中華人民共和国個人情報保護法 第53条（全国人民代表大会の英文）
PIPL 53.quote: Article 53 Personal information processors outside the territory of the People’s Republic of China as specified in the second paragraph of Article 3 of this Law shall set up specialized agencies or designate representatives within the territory of the People’s Republic of China to be responsible for handling personal information protection related matters, and shall submit the names, contact information, and other information of the agencies and representatives to the departments with personal information protection duties.

Thailand PDPA 37.name: Thailand, Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562, section 37(5) (ETDA’s English translation, marked unofficial)
Thailand PDPA 37.name_ja: タイ 個人データ保護法（仏暦2562年）第37条第5号（ETDA の英訳。非公式と記されたもの）
Thailand PDPA 37.quote: (5) in the event of being the Data Controller pursuant to section 5 paragraph two, the Data Controller shall designate in writing a representative of the Data Controller who must be in the Kingdom of Thailand and be authorized to act on behalf of the Data Controller without any limitation of liability with respect to the collection, use or disclosure of the Personal Data according to the purposes of the Data Controller.

Thailand PDPA 38.name: Thailand, Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562, section 38 (ETDA’s English translation, marked unofficial; the quotation stops where a page break of the PDF falls)
Thailand PDPA 38.name_ja: タイ 個人データ保護法（仏暦2562年）第38条（ETDA の英訳。非公式と記されたもの。PDF の頁の変わり目の手前までを引く）
Thailand PDPA 38.quote: Section 38 The provisions of t h e representative designation in section 37 (5) shall not apply to the following Data Controller: (1) the Data Controller which is a public authority as prescribed and announced by the Committee; (2) the Data Controller which engages in the profession or business of collecting, using, or disclosing Personal Data, that does not have the nature pursuant to section 26, and does not have a large amount of Personal Data as prescribed by the Committee

DSA 11.name: Digital Services Act (EU) 2022/2065, Article 11(1)
DSA 11.name_ja: デジタルサービス法（EU 2022/2065）第11条第1項
DSA 11.quote: 1. Providers of intermediary services shall designate a single point of contact to enable them to communicate directly, by electronic means, with Member States’ authorities, the Commission and the Board referred to in Article 61 for the application of this Regulation.

DSA 12.name: Digital Services Act (EU) 2022/2065, Article 12(1)
DSA 12.name_ja: デジタルサービス法（EU 2022/2065）第12条第1項
DSA 12.quote: 1. Providers of intermediary services shall designate a single point of contact to enable recipients of the service to communicate directly and rapidly with them, by electronic means and in a user-friendly manner, including by allowing recipients of the service to choose the means of communication, which shall not solely rely on automated tools.

DSA 13.name: Digital Services Act (EU) 2022/2065, Article 13(1)
DSA 13.name_ja: デジタルサービス法（EU 2022/2065）第13条第1項
DSA 13.quote: 1. Providers of intermediary services which do not have an establishment in the Union but which offer services in the Union shall designate, in writing, a legal or natural person to act as their legal representative in one of the Member States where the provider offers its services.

DSA 14.name: Digital Services Act (EU) 2022/2065, Article 14(1), first sentence
DSA 14.name_ja: デジタルサービス法（EU 2022/2065）第14条第1項第1文
DSA 14.quote: 1. Providers of intermediary services shall include information on any restrictions that they impose in relation to the use of their service in respect of information provided by the recipients of the service, in their terms and conditions.

DSA 16.name: Digital Services Act (EU) 2022/2065, Article 16(1), first sentence
DSA 16.name_ja: デジタルサービス法（EU 2022/2065）第16条第1項第1文
DSA 16.quote: 1. Providers of hosting services shall put mechanisms in place to allow any individual or entity to notify them of the presence on their service of specific items of information that the individual or entity considers to be illegal content.

DSA 17.name: Digital Services Act (EU) 2022/2065, Article 17(1), opening words
DSA 17.name_ja: デジタルサービス法（EU 2022/2065）第17条第1項の柱書き
DSA 17.quote: 1. Providers of hosting services shall provide a clear and specific statement of reasons to any affected recipients of the service for any of the following restrictions imposed on the ground that the information provided by the recipient of the service is illegal content or incompatible with their terms and conditions:

DSA 18.name: Digital Services Act (EU) 2022/2065, Article 18(1)
DSA 18.name_ja: デジタルサービス法（EU 2022/2065）第18条第1項
DSA 18.quote: 1. Where a provider of hosting services becomes aware of any information giving rise to a suspicion that a criminal offence involving a threat to the life or safety of a person or persons has taken place, is taking place or is likely to take place, it shall promptly inform the law enforcement or judicial authorities of the Member State or Member States concerned of its suspicion and provide all relevant information available.

DSA 20.name: Digital Services Act (EU) 2022/2065, Article 20(1), opening words
DSA 20.name_ja: デジタルサービス法（EU 2022/2065）第20条第1項の冒頭
DSA 20.quote: 1. Providers of online platforms shall provide recipients of the service, including individuals or entities that have submitted a notice, for a period of at least six months following the decision referred to in this paragraph, with access to an effective internal complaint-handling system that enables them to lodge complaints, electronically and free of charge,

DSA 21.name: Digital Services Act (EU) 2022/2065, Article 21(1), first subparagraph
DSA 21.name_ja: デジタルサービス法（EU 2022/2065）第21条第1項第1段
DSA 21.quote: 1. Recipients of the service, including individuals or entities that have submitted notices, addressed by the decisions referred to in Article 20(1) shall be entitled to select any out-of-court dispute settlement body that has been certified in accordance with paragraph 3 of this Article in order to resolve disputes relating to those decisions, including complaints that have not been resolved by means of the internal complaint-handling system referred to in that Article.

DSA 24.name: Digital Services Act (EU) 2022/2065, Article 24(3), first sentence
DSA 24.name_ja: デジタルサービス法（EU 2022/2065）第24条第3項第1文
DSA 24.quote: 3. Providers of online platforms or of online search engines shall communicate to the Digital Services Coordinator of establishment and the Commission, upon their request and without undue delay, the information referred to in paragraph 2, updated to the moment of such request.

Russia 152-FZ 1.name: Federal Law No. 152-FZ on Personal Data, Article 1, part 1.1
Russia 152-FZ 1.name_ja: 個人データに関する連邦法第 152-FZ 号 第 1 条第 1.1 項
Russia 152-FZ 1.quote: Положения настоящего Федерального закона применяются к обработке персональных данных граждан Российской Федерации, осуществляемой иностранными юридическими лицами или иностранными физическими лицами, на основании договора, стороной которого являются граждане Российской Федерации, иных соглашений между иностранными юридическими лицами, иностранными физическими лицами и гражданами Российской Федерации либо на основании согласия гражданина Российской Федерации на обработку его персональных данных.

Russia 152-FZ 18.name: Federal Law No. 152-FZ on Personal Data, Article 18, part 5
Russia 152-FZ 18.name_ja: 個人データに関する連邦法第 152-FZ 号 第 18 条第 5 項
Russia 152-FZ 18.quote: При сборе персональных данных, в том числе посредством информационно-телекоммуникационной сети "Интернет", запись, систематизация, накопление, хранение, уточнение (обновление, изменение), извлечение персональных данных граждан Российской Федерации с использованием баз данных, находящихся за пределами территории Российской Федерации, не допускаются, за исключением случаев, указанных в пунктах 2, 3, 4, 8 части 1 статьи 6 настоящего Федерального закона.

Monaco Law 1.565 25.name: Law No. 1.565 of 3 December 2024 on the protection of personal data (Monaco), Article 25
Monaco Law 1.565 25.name_ja: 個人データの保護に関する 2024 年 12 月 3 日の法律第 1.565 号（モナコ）第 25 条
Monaco Law 1.565 25.quote: Lorsque le traitement concerne le second tiret du chiffre 1 de l'article 3, le responsable du traitement ou le sous-traitant désigne par tous moyens écrits un représentant dans la Principauté de Monaco ou, à défaut, au sein d'un État membre de l'Union européenne. Ce dernier est mandaté pour être le contact des personnes concernées par le traitement et de l'autorité de protection à qui elles peuvent s'adresser pour toutes questions. Cette obligation ne s'applique pas : à un traitement occasionnel, qui n'implique pas un traitement à grande échelle de données sensibles

Argentina Law 25.326 6.name: Law No. 25.326 on the Protection of Personal Data (Argentina), Article 6(b)
Argentina Law 25.326 6.name_ja: 個人データ保護法（アルゼンチン、法律第 25.326 号）第 6 条 b
Argentina Law 25.326 6.quote: Cuando se recaben datos personales se deberá informar previamente a sus titulares en forma expresa y clara: a) La finalidad para la que serán tratados y quiénes pueden ser sus destinatarios o clase de destinatarios; b) La existencia del archivo, registro, banco de datos, electrónico o de cualquier otro tipo, de que se trate y la identidad y domicilio de su responsable;

Argentina Law 25.326 12.name: Law No. 25.326 on the Protection of Personal Data (Argentina), Article 12(1)
Argentina Law 25.326 12.name_ja: 個人データ保護法（アルゼンチン、法律第 25.326 号）第 12 条第 1 項
Argentina Law 25.326 12.quote: 1. Es prohibida la transferencia de datos personales de cualquier tipo con países u organismos internacionales o supranacionales, que no propocionen niveles de protección adecuados.

Argentina Law 25.326 21.name: Law No. 25.326 on the Protection of Personal Data (Argentina), Article 21(1)
Argentina Law 25.326 21.name_ja: 個人データ保護法（アルゼンチン、法律第 25.326 号）第 21 条第 1 項
Argentina Law 25.326 21.quote: 1. Todo archivo, registro, base o banco de datos público, y privado destinado a proporcionar informes debe inscribirse en el Registro que al efecto habilite el organismo de control.

Uruguay Law 18.331 3.name: Law No. 18.331 on the Protection of Personal Data (Uruguay), Article 3
Uruguay Law 18.331 3.name_ja: 個人データ保護法（ウルグアイ、法律第 18.331 号）第 3 条
Uruguay Law 18.331 3.quote: El régimen de la presente ley será de aplicación a los datos personales registrados en cualquier soporte que los haga susceptibles de tratamiento, y a toda modalidad de uso posterior de estos datos por los ámbitos público o privado.

Uruguay Law 18.331 13.name: Law No. 18.331 on the Protection of Personal Data (Uruguay), Article 13(B)
Uruguay Law 18.331 13.name_ja: 個人データ保護法（ウルグアイ、法律第 18.331 号）第 13 条 B
Uruguay Law 18.331 13.quote: Cuando se recaben datos personales se deberá informar previamente a sus titulares en forma expresa, precisa e inequívoca: A) La finalidad para la que serán tratados y quiénes pueden ser sus destinatarios o clase de destinatarios. B) La existencia de la base de datos, electrónico o de cualquier otro tipo, de que se trate, la identidad y domicilio de su responsable.

Uruguay Law 18.331 29.name: Law No. 18.331 on the Protection of Personal Data (Uruguay), Article 29
Uruguay Law 18.331 29.name_ja: 個人データ保護法（ウルグアイ、法律第 18.331 号）第 29 条
Uruguay Law 18.331 29.quote: Toda base de datos pública o privada debe inscribirse en el Registro que al efecto habilite el Organo de Control, de acuerdo a los criterios reglamentarios que se establezcan.

Colombia Law 1581 7.name: Law 1581 of 2012 (Colombia), Article 7
Colombia Law 1581 7.name_ja: 2012 年法律第 1581 号（コロンビア）第 7 条
Colombia Law 1581 7.quote: Queda proscrito el Tratamiento de datos personales de niños, niñas y adolescentes, salvo aquellos datos que sean de naturaleza pública.

Colombia Law 1581 12.name: Law 1581 of 2012 (Colombia), Article 12(d)
Colombia Law 1581 12.name_ja: 2012 年法律第 1581 号（コロンビア）第 12 条 d
Colombia Law 1581 12.quote: El Responsable del Tratamiento, al momento de solicitar al Titular la autorización, deberá informarle de manera clara y expresa lo siguiente: a) El Tratamiento al cual serán sometidos sus datos personales y la finalidad del mismo; b) El carácter facultativo de la respuesta a las preguntas que le sean hechas, cuando estas versen sobre datos sensibles o sobre los datos de las niñas, niños y adolescentes; c) Los derechos que le asisten como Titular; d) La identificación, dirección física o electrónica y teléfono del Responsable del Tratamiento.

Mexico LFPDPPP 1.name: Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (Mexico), Article 1
Mexico LFPDPPP 1.name_ja: 私人が保有する個人データの保護に関する連邦法（メキシコ）第 1 条
Mexico LFPDPPP 1.quote: La presente Ley es de orden público y de observancia general en todo el territorio nacional y tiene por objeto la protección de los datos personales en posesión de los particulares

Mexico LFPDPPP 15.name: Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (Mexico), Article 15(I)
Mexico LFPDPPP 15.name_ja: 私人が保有する個人データの保護に関する連邦法（メキシコ）第 15 条第 I 号
Mexico LFPDPPP 15.quote: El aviso de privacidad deberá contener, al menos, la siguiente información: I. La identidad y domicilio del responsable;

Ghana DPA 2012 45.name: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843) (Ghana), section 45(1)
Ghana DPA 2012 45.name_ja: 2012 年データ保護法（ガーナ、法律第 843 号）第 45 条第 1 項
Ghana DPA 2012 45.quote: (1) Except as otherwise provided, this Act applies to a data control- ler in respect of data where (a) the data controller is established in this country and the data is processed in this country, (b) the data controller is not established in this country but uses equipment or a data processor carrying on business in this country to process the data, or (c) processing is in respect of information which originates partly or wholly from this country.

Ghana DPA 2012 46.name: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843) (Ghana), section 46(3)
Ghana DPA 2012 46.name_ja: 2012 年データ保護法（ガーナ、法律第 843 号）第 46 条第 3 項
Ghana DPA 2012 46.quote: (3) A data controller shall register with the Commission.

Ghana DPA 2012 53.name: Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843) (Ghana), section 53
Ghana DPA 2012 53.name_ja: 2012 年データ保護法（ガーナ、法律第 843 号）第 53 条
Ghana DPA 2012 53.quote: A data controller who has not been registered under this Act shall not process personal data.

Korea PIPA 22-2.name: Personal Information Protection Act (Korea; KLRI's English translation), Article 22-2(1)
Korea PIPA 22-2.name_ja: 個人情報保護法（大韓民国、韓国法制研究院の英訳）第 22 条の 2 第 1 項
Korea PIPA 22-2.quote: (1) When the consent of a child under 14 years of age is required to process the personal information of such child, a personal information controller shall obtain the consent of his or her legal representative and confirm whether the legal representative has granted consent.

Korea PIPA 28-8.name: Personal Information Protection Act (Korea; KLRI's English translation), Article 28-8(2)
Korea PIPA 28-8.name_ja: 個人情報保護法（大韓民国、韓国法制研究院の英訳）第 28 条の 8 第 2 項
Korea PIPA 28-8.quote: (2) A personal information controller shall inform data subjects of the following matters in advance when obtaining consent under paragraph (1) 1: 1. Particulars of the personal information to be transferred; 2. The country to which the personal information is transferred, transfer date, and method; 3. Name of the recipient of personal information (referring to the name of a corporation and the contact information of the corporation, if the recipient is a corporation); 4. The purpose of using personal information by the recipient of personal information and the period of retention and use of personal information; 5. The method and procedure for refusing the transfer of personal information and the effect of such refusal.

Saudi PDPL 29.name: Personal Data Protection Law (Saudi Arabia; SDAIA's English translation), Article 29
Saudi PDPL 29.name_ja: 個人データ保護法（サウジアラビア、SDAIA の英訳）第 29 条
Saudi PDPL 29.quote: 2-The conditions that must be met when there is a Transfer or Disclosure of Personal Data, according to what is stated in Paragraph (1) of this Article, are as follows: A. The Transfer or Disclosure shall not cause any prejudice to national security or the vital interests of the Kingdom. B. There is an adequate level of protection for Personal Data outside the Kingdom. Such level of protection shall be at least equivalent to the level of protection guaranteed by the Law and Regulations, according to the results of an assessment conducted by the Competent Authority in coordination with whomever it deems appropriate from the other relevant authorities.

Philippines DPA 2012 6.name: Data Privacy Act of 2012 (the Philippines), section 6
Philippines DPA 2012 6.name_ja: 2012 年データプライバシー法（フィリピン）第 6 条
Philippines DPA 2012 6.quote: This Act applies to an act done or practice engaged in and outside of the Philippines by an entity if: (a) The act, practice or processing relates to personal information about a Philippine citizen or a resident;

Philippines DPA 2012 21.name: Data Privacy Act of 2012 (the Philippines), section 21(a)
Philippines DPA 2012 21.name_ja: 2012 年データプライバシー法（フィリピン）第 21 条 a
Philippines DPA 2012 21.quote: (a) The personal information controller is accountable for complying with the requirements of this Act and shall use contractual or other reasonable means to provide a comparable level of protection while the information are being processed by a third party.

Zimbabwe DPA 4.name: Cyber and Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07] (Zimbabwe), section 4(2)(a), as ZimLII gives it
Zimbabwe DPA 4.name_ja: サイバー・データ保護法（ジンバブエ、第 12 章 07）第 4 条第 2 項 a（ZimLII の写し）
Zimbabwe DPA 4.quote: (2) Subject to subsection (1) this Act shall be applicable— (a) to the processing of data carried out in the context of the effective and actual activities of any data controller;

Zimbabwe DPA 28.name: Cyber and Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07] (Zimbabwe), section 28(1), as ZimLII gives it
Zimbabwe DPA 28.name_ja: サイバー・データ保護法（ジンバブエ、第 12 章 07）第 28 条第 1 項（ZimLII の写し）
Zimbabwe DPA 28.quote: (1) Subject to the provisions of this Act, a data controller may not transfer personal information about a data subject to a third party who is in a foreign country unless an adequate level of protection is ensured in the country of the recipient or within the recipient international organisation and the data is transferred solely to allow tasks covered by the competence of the controller to be carried out.

New Zealand Privacy Act 2020 22.name: Privacy Act 2020 (New Zealand), section 22, information privacy principle 12(1)(a), as the Internet Archive kept it on 2026-09-26
New Zealand Privacy Act 2020 22.name_ja: 2020 年プライバシー法（ニュージーランド）第 22 条、情報プライバシー原則 12 第 1 項 a（Internet Archive の 2026-09-26 の写し）
New Zealand Privacy Act 2020 22.quote: Information privacy principle 12 Disclosure of personal information outside New Zealand (1) An agency ( A) may disclose personal information to a foreign person or entity ( B) in reliance on IPP 11(1) (a), (c), (e), (f), (h), or (i) only if— (a) the individual concerned authorises the disclosure to B after being expressly informed by A that B may not be required to protect the information in a way that, overall, provides comparable safeguards to those in this Act;

Swiss FADP 17.name: Federal Act on Data Protection (Switzerland; Fedlex's English translation, which has no legal force), Article 17(1)(a)
Swiss FADP 17.name_ja: 連邦データ保護法（スイス、Fedlex の英訳、法的効力のない訳）第 17 条第 1 項 a
Swiss FADP 17.quote: 1 In derogation from Article 16 paragraphs 1 and 2, personal data may be disclosed abroad in the following cases: a. The data subject has explicitly consented to disclosure.
